name: Trading Swarm skill
title_zh: 在聊天框里直接指挥交易员改盯盘清单
tagline_zh: 不用切终端、不用翻日志，问一句就知道它在盯什么、想开什么仓；说一声就改风控和策略，像给交易员发微信。
tagline_en: Ask what it's watching, propose a trade, or tighten risk—all from chat. No terminal, no log diving, just talk to.
desc_en: Drive the Trading Swarm trading agent (market state, strategy threads, proposals, reviews, workflow settings) from any host agent through its local HTTP API. Use when the user asks about what the trading agent is doing, wants to propose or close a trade idea, or wants to change the agent's watch list / risk / playbook.
why_zh: 把交易代理的 HTTP API 包成自然语言动作，宿主 Agent 能读状态、提策略、审提案、改设置。
why_en: Wraps the trading agent's HTTP API into natural-language actions—read state, propose ideas, review, adjust risk—so any host.
limit_zh: 只连本地 HTTP API，交易代理得自己先跑起来；只管策略与风控设置，不碰下单执行；改设置前不替你确认资金安全。
limit_en: Requires the trading agent's local HTTP API running. Handles strategy & risk config only—no order execution. No safety check before changing.
title_en: Drive your trading agent from chat
